title: NASA Seeks Partners to Build a Nuclear Reactor for the Moon
paragraphs: NASA wants to build a power plant for the Moon. It is a small nuclear reactor. NASA calls it Lunar Reactor-1.
The reactor makes 20 kilowatts of power. That is enough for about 16 homes in the United States for one year. It can help a future Moon base.
NASA wants the reactor ready to launch by 2030. It should work on the Moon for five years. NASA asks companies to send ideas by December 21.
